Overnight contingency — if ALTO gaps down ≥6% at next open, auto-liquidate remaining cash ALTO and close the call spreads (market-on-open) and buy back NASDAQ futures to neutralize exposure.  
If ALTO gaps up ≥5% at next open, trim 50% of the cash position and unwind 50% of the call spreads, and buy back futures proportionally to lock profits and reduce overnight gamma.  
Rationale: IR reaffirmation plus improving flow gives positive asymmetric expected return; this keeps upside via limited-cost options, caps single-name and index risk, and provides clear, executable gap callbacks for Risk/PM.
